statement: A candidate that an instance cannot compile or evaluate (CANDIDATE_ERROR) closes the window at once, and the change never publishes. An instance that reads the staged list compiles each window's candidate when it first sees the window, whatever its traffic, and one that does not compile is CANDIDATE_ERROR in that cycle's report; it compiles on the reporter's coroutine, one candidate at a time, never on the snapshot source's compile pool, so windows staged while documents load cold make no load fail; and for at most one report interval per cycle, checked between candidates, the longest waiting first, so the reports and the status are written every cycle and every window is compiled within a few cycles of its staging.
